# Solar Icons

Icons: Solar Icon Set by 480 Design, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

Source: https://github.com/480-Design/Solar-icon-set

License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Distribution: `@solar-icons/static` 2.7.0, source commit `ab241e1bf578dcfe45b0197aee59bd9a08b5fe68`.
See the [pinned third-party notice](https://github.com/saoudi-h/solar-icons/blob/ab241e1bf578dcfe45b0197aee59bd9a08b5fe68/LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY) and the accompanying package MIT notice.
The standalone SVGs are unmodified. The generated sprite wraps their artwork in symbols and the app recolors the primary and secondary layers with theme tokens. The send and stop controls render both layers in opaque white.
